olivia: Quick quarterly roundup: recurring incident themes = KV evictions, autoscaler oscillation, model-load OOMs. Need owners and timelines.
sam: Can we do a short action list and owners now so tracker gets seeded?
parker: I'll own autoscaler smoothing. Plan: add 60s hysteresis + preserve-min-nodes. due: 2026-05-12
emma: I'll take KV durability: per-customer TTL heuristics + eviction metrics + short-term global TTL bump. due: 2026-05-07
sam: I'll own model-load rollouts: prefetch stage + memory budget checks + staged canary. due: 2026-05-10
incident-bot: Reminder: link PRs to PM IDs PM-2026-0311 and PM-2026-0227.
olivia: Proposed acceptance criteria: KV eviction down 80% for top customers; autoscale latency spikes <2x; model rollout rollback rate <1%.
parker: I'll add a synthetic load test to validate autoscaler changes.
emma: Question: prefer sidecar disk fallback for KV or runtime change? sidecar first.
sam: Agreed. Keep feature-flagged per-customer rollout.
olivia: Creating tracker board now and will assign owners. Checkpoint in two weeks: 2026-05-02. Post updates in tracker or here.
incident-bot: Checkpoint scheduled 2026-05-02 17:00 UTC.
